changelog:
- Initial release of shopping-memory skill.
- Remembers shopping lists, recent purchases, prices, and purchase timing for errands and budget tracking.
- Supports adding, recalling, and recording items using BlueColumn API (API key required).
- Enables agents to answer questions like "do we need X?", track purchase history, and plan restocks.
- Includes usage workflow and API examples for quick integration.
summary: Shopping memory that holds lists, purchases, prices, and "last time I bought X" so agents can help with errands, restocks, and budget questions. Use when an agent tracks household or business purchasing. Requires a BlueColumn API key (bc_live_*).
